title: Governor Type 3
text: IEEE 类型 3 线性化调速水轮机模型，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Speed reference (pu)} 指定转速参考、{Initial torque (pu)} 指定初始转矩、{Gate servomotor time constant, T_g (s)} 指定闸门伺服电动机时间常数、{Pilot value time constant, T_p (s)} 指定先导值时间常数、{Opening gate rate limit, U_o (pu/s)} 指定闸门开启速率限值、{Closing gate rate limit, U_c (pu/s)} 指定闸门关闭速率限值、{Maximum gate position, on MVA capability, P_max (pu)} 指定闸门最大位置、{Minimum gate position, on MVA capability, P_min (pu)} 指定闸门最小位置、{Permanent speed droop coefficient, R_perm (pu)} 指定永久转速下垂系数、{Transient speed droop coefficient, R_temp (pu)} 指定瞬态转速下垂系数、{Governor time constant, T_r (s)} 指定调速器时间常数、{Water starting time constant, T_w (s)} 指定水流启动时间常数、{Penstock coefficient, a_11} 指定压力管道动态系数、{Penstock coefficient, a_13} 指定压力管道动态系数、{Penstock coefficient, a_21} 指定压力管道动态系数、{Penstock coefficient, a_23} 指定压力管道动态系数，按实例取值。

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar

params.name: Gate servomotor time constant, T_g (s)
params.values: 闸门伺服电动机时间常数 0.52 (default) | scalar

params.name: Opening gate rate limit, U_o (pu/s)
params.values: 闸门开启速率限值 0.15 (default) | scalar

params.name: Closing gate rate limit, U_c (pu/s)
params.values: 闸门关闭速率限值 -0.15 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum gate position, on MVA capability, P_max (pu)
Minimum gate position, on MVA capability, P_min (pu)
Permanent speed droop coefficient, R_perm (pu)
params.values: 永久转速下垂系数 0.05 (default) | scalar

params.name: Transient speed droop coefficient, R_temp (pu)
params.values: 瞬态转速下垂系数 0.6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Water starting time constant, T_w (s)
params.values: 水流启动时间常数 5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Penstock coefficient, a_11
params.values: 压力管道动态系数 0.75 (default) | scalar

params.name: Penstock coefficient, a_13
params.values: 压力管道动态系数 0.75 (default) | scalar

params.name: Penstock coefficient, a_21
params.values: 压力管道动态系数 0.75 (default) | scalar

params.name: Penstock coefficient, a_23
params.values: 压力管道动态系数 0.75 (default) | scalar
